description:
## Goal

Correct the readiness telemetry test and documentation after fz-kdt.45 made direct DeriveExecutableFacts jobs stand on settled semantic facts. Attribute the newly live readiness cause to the direct scheduler fact boundary, not to later root-scanner deletion.

## Evidence

At 548dbd87b, immediately before fz-kdt.45, the 00181 trace has 278 applied completions, 421 product settlements, 37 quiescence events, and zero scheduler readiness wakes. At 446374021, fz-kdt.45, it has 308 applied completions, 408 product settlements, 34 quiescence events, and 21 readiness wakes: 18 enqueued and 3 coalesced. The fz-tfn.5 candidate has the identical signal, proving root-scanner deletion did not introduce it.

The existing fz2_cli assertion still requires wakes == 0, so the current delivery head fails that integration test even though causal replay correctly attributes the wakes.

## TDD and acceptance

1. Reproduce the old zero-wake assertion failing on current delivery head.
2. Pin that readiness wakes are nonzero, derive from Settled ActivationAnalyzed/CallSiteSummary uses that wake DeriveExecutableFacts, and produce a nonzero readiness-caused total with no uncaused evaluations.
3. Update telemetry documentation with the exact fz-kdt.45 direct-fact cause.
4. Do not change scheduling behavior or weaken other causal invariants.
5. Run focused/full fz2_cli, library tests as needed, formatting, and strict clippy.

This ticket blocks fz-tfn.5 so its commit contains only root-scanner deletion and can be rebased on the corrected integration contract.
title: Correct readiness telemetry after direct ExecutableFacts scheduling
